title: Daily Temperatures
description: Given an array of integers `temperatures` representing daily temperatures, return an array `answer` such that `answer[i]` is the number of days you have to wait after the `i`th day to get a warmer temperature. If no future day is warmer, answer[i] = 0.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` temperatures.
hints: Store indices in a stack maintaining decreasing temperature order.
When a warmer temperature is encountered, calculate distance `i - prev`.
Pop resolved indices and record their waiting days.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    temps = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    ans = [0] * n
    stk = []
    for i, t in enumerate(temps):
        while stk and temps[stk[-1]] < t:
            prev = stk.pop()
            ans[prev] = i - prev
        stk.append(i)
    print(' '.join(map(str, ans)))
